title: Lucretia Mott's birth chart
metaDescription: Lucretia Mott's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 13.9° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Six of the ten placements whose signs are settled fall in fixed signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. The fixed signs hold what the cardinal signs start; a chart weighted there finishes its sentences.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 13.9° of Capricorn is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Venus in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 8.8° Capricorn, Venus was at 20.5° Aquarius, Mars was at 14.2° Aquarius. Read together: thought with its feet on the ground; attraction that begins as conversation; effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Uranus and Pluto — a opposition holding at 1.1°. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner. Behind it, Jupiter square Uranus at 1.4°, and Venus conjunction Pluto at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus opposes Uranus while both square Jupiter. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, one placement stands out. Saturn in Aries at 25.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: earth 3, air 3, water 2, fire 2 across the elements, and fixed 6, cardinal 3, mutable 1 across the modalities. An earth emphasis reads as trust in the tangible: the plan matters less than whether the thing stands up. Mercury and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Virgo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 23.0°.
